character.name: Stoddles the Jawless, Scourge of the Shattered Maw
character.background: Death Knight, former champion sacrificed to necromancy

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: You extend a necrotic frost-chilled hand to touch a creature within 120 feet. The target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Death Knell
spells.description: You drain the last spark of life from a dying creature within 60 feet, dealing 1d4 necrotic damage and healing yourself for half the damage dealt.

spells.name: Anti-Magic Shell
spells.description: You surround yourself with a shimmering barrier of anti-magic energy that absorbs incoming spell damage and nullifies all hostile magical effects for 1 minute, or until you dismiss it.

spells.name: Death Coil
spells.description: You hurl a bolt of necrotic energy at a creature or point within 60 feet. The target takes 2d8 necrotic damage, or you can choose to heal yourself for half that amount instead.

traits: Undead Resilience: Immune to poison, disease, and exhaustion; does not need to breathe, eat, drink, or sleep
Runefrost Aura: Non-magical weapons that hit Stoddles have a 50% chance to shatter, and his cold damage ignores resistance
Deathbound: When reduced to 0 HP, can roll a DC 10 CON save to stabilize and retain 1 HP, once per long rest
Fearsome Presence: Creatures within 10 feet have disadvantage on saving throws against fear effects
character.gear: Frost-blackened plate armor · Greatsword "Mawbreaker" · Tattered blood-stained cloak · Spiked iron gauntlets · 3 necrotic rations · Spectral bone shield · Unholy rune symbol of the Shattered Maw
character.story: Once a northern king’s champion, Stoddles was betrayed by his liege and sacrificed to the Rite of the Shattered Maw, his jaw torn away to silence his vows of loyalty. Forged into an unholy death knight, he broke his necromancer masters’ control and hunted them to the last, their dark arts now his own. He wanders frozen battlefields, a living nightmare who duels arrogant heroes and crushes those who would raise the dead. His flopping tongue tastes living fear, and his hunger for vengeance is never sated.

inventory.name: Mawbreaker
inventory.lore: Forged in the fires of the Shattered Maw ritual, Mawbreaker was bound to Stoddles’ soul when his jaw was torn away. It has drunk the blood of a hundred necromancers and grows stronger with each kill.
inventory.description: A massive rune-etched greatsword forged from the melted weapons of the necromancers who bound Stoddles. It hums with a low, hungry vibration, and its blade is permanently rimed with necrotic frost.

inventory.name: Frost-blackened plate armor
inventory.lore: This armor was forged for Stoddles when he was reborn as a death knight, forged from the enchanted plate of his old order and reinforced with the bones of his betrayers. The runes are bound to his soul, repairing minor damage when he feeds on enemy life force.
inventory.description: Heavy plate armor blackened by frost and necrotic energy, etched with glowing pale blue runes that bleed light when Stoddles is angered.

inventory.name: Tattered blood-stained cloak
inventory.lore: Stoddles tore this cloak from his own shoulders when he was crowned champion, carrying it through the ritual that made him undying. It flutters like carrion wings when he moves, and the stains never fade.
inventory.description: A heavy wool cloak, once the royal standard of Stoddles’ old kingdom, now stained with centuries of blood and rot.

inventory.name: Spiked gauntlets
inventory.lore: These gauntlets were taken from the high necromancer who led the ritual that created Stoddles, ripped from his corpse after Stoddles broke free of his bindings.
inventory.description: Heavy iron gauntlets lined with rusted iron spikes, encrusted with necrotic frost that chills anything it touches.

inventory.name: Spectral bone shield
inventory.lore: This shield is formed from the bones of the soldiers who died defending Stoddles’ old kingdom, bound to his will by the necromantic ritual. It absorbs physical and magical damage, cracking only when Stoddles is gravely wounded.
inventory.description: A shimmering shield of fused spectral bone that phases into existence when Stoddles calls upon his runic power.
inventory.effects: Absorbs up to 15 points of damage per charge, recharges 1 charge at dawn.

inventory.name: Necrotic rations (3)
inventory.lore: These rations were created by Stoddles’ necromancer masters to feed their death knight soldiers, made from the flesh of traitors and deserters. They taste of ash and cold, but sustain Stoddles without need for normal food.
inventory.description: Dried strips of corrupted meat that never rot, providing sustenance for undead creatures.
inventory.effects: Provides 1 day of sustenance per ration, no need for water or normal food.

inventory.name: Unholy rune symbol of the Shattered Maw
inventory.lore: This symbol was carved from the very altar where Stoddles was sacrificed, bound to his soul to amplify his unholy powers. It is the key to breaking the last of his masters’ lingering bindings.
inventory.description: A jagged runestone carved from the heart of the Shattered Maw, glowing with pale blue necrotic light.
inventory.effects: Can be used to cast Death Coil at 3rd level once per charge, and grants +1 to unholy spell attack rolls.
